verdict.rationale: NVIDIA claims the H200 delivers higher performance "within the same power profile as the H100" and offers an air-cooled NVL variant for lower-power deployments, but this is vendor marketing, not a documented power envelope (TDP curves) or independent perf-per-watt benchmarking. Community evidence focuses on memory/throughput (tokens/sec, cost) rather than power efficiency. missing for 10: independent performance-per-watt measurements, published sustained-workload power/thermal curves, third-party efficiency benchmarks.
